prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. One square painterly bestiary illustration of Dahu, an Alpine chamois-like goat-antelope with two small curved horns. Exactly FOUR legs, but the animal's TWO LEFT-SIDE LEGS are conspicuously SHORTER than its TWO RIGHT-SIDE LEGS. View from FRONT THREE-QUARTER: animal facing toward viewer and slightly to image-left, show chest and both sides clearly. Its anatomical LEFT side is on the RIGHT of this frontal image and UPHILL on the steep slope; those two legs are very short. Its anatomical RIGHT side is on the LEFT of image and DOWNHILL; those two legs are long. The terrain rises to image-right. All four hooves contact the hillside and torso remains approximately level. Keep every leg visible with no overlaps. Beautiful Alpine hillside, believable fur and anatomy, copper sunset forest-green palette, no wings, no extra legs, no text, no diagrams, no labels, no watermark.
